text: The annual spirit festival fills the town with lanterns and merchants.

outcomes.text: You find a rare pill at a bargain.

choices.label: Show off cultivation tricks for coins

outcomes.text: The crowd cheers and tosses you coins.

text: While wandering, you discover a hidden cave humming with spiritual energy.

outcomes.text: Inside you find a pool of spirit liquid!
A beast lairs inside and mauls you.
Discretion is the better part of valor.

text: You spot a glowing spirit herb growing on a cliff.
A crumbling ancient altar offers a trial: solve its formation to claim a cultivator's inheritance.

outcomes.text: The formation yields! A torrent of knowledge and qi fills you.
You leave the ancient relics in peace.

text: Recruiters from three great sects tour the nearby towns, testing the talent of young cultivators.

choices.label: Join the righteous Azure Cloud Sect

outcomes.text: You are accepted as an outer disciple.

choices.label: Join the shadowy Blood Moon Sect

outcomes.text: The Blood Moon Sect teaches fast but ruthless methods.

choices.label: Join the scholarly Verdant Pill Pavilion

outcomes.text: The alchemists take you in as a herb gatherer and hand you a heavy book.
